headline: GTA 6's preload date is finally settled, Haas cuts Ocon loose before Interlagos, and OpenAI claims an AI pipeline built 948 Linux root exploits for about $1.2m.

F1 FP3 14:30, qualifying 18:00 (no sprint). UFC Vegas 124: prelims 22:00, main card 01:00 Sun Irish time. ADCC Brazilian Nationals also run 7-8 Nov

items.headline: OpenAI says an AI pipeline built 948 Linux root exploits for $1.2m
items.summary: A prototype using an upcoming cyber model scanned about 2.8 million lines of a desktop kernel and reproduced 1,724 flaws, with working exploits and candidate patches for 948 privilege-escalation bugs. These are OpenAI's own numbers, and I read them via a digest because the post wouldn't load.

items.headline: Xen advisory credits Claude with finding VM-escape flaws
items.summary: XSA-523 covers two bugs in Xen's grant-copy operation that let a malicious guest read and write other VMs' memory, including dom0, on every release from 4.6 onward. Worth a look if you run Xen; this comes from a digest, not the advisory itself.
items.source: The Hacker News via AI Weekly

items.headline: Democrats win Congress and AI data-centre stocks take the hit
items.summary: Hut 8 fell 23% and IREN 11% while Microsoft, Amazon and Alphabet rose. The worry is state-level moratoria, which Goldman economists reportedly think could touch about 45% of planned US capacity growth; that figure is second-hand.

items.headline: Chips: Qualcomm slides, AMD prices its Taalas deal
items.summary: Qualcomm's fiscal Q4 revenue fell 8% to $10.44bn with handset chips down 26%, and the stock dropped about 6% after hours despite a $5bn data-centre target for FY27. Separately, an AMD filing puts the Taalas inference-chip purchase at about $2.9bn, $1.4bn of it contingent.

items.headline: Spacewalk today to fit the ISS's last roll-out solar array
items.summary: Mission managers have cleared two astronauts to go outside on Thursday and install the eighth and final array, finishing the station's power upgrade. I could only see NASA's listing, so no start time.

items.headline: NASA sets out plans to speed up Artemis
items.summary: Leadership gave an update on the path to putting Americans back on the lunar surface in 2028. The full article wouldn't load, so I can't vouch for the specifics of what changes.

items.headline: One spacecraft ends, two more swing by: Swift re-enters, ESCAPADE flies past Earth
items.summary: The Swift observatory came down on Wednesday after almost 22 years in orbit. NASA's twin ESCAPADE probes are due powered Earth flybys within days on their way to Mars, a manoeuvre NASA says no agency spacecraft has flown before.

items.headline: SLAC reports proof of a third type of magnetism; AI finds a 'natural Ozempic'
items.summary: ScienceDaily's picks: SLAC scientists claim conclusive evidence for a third magnetic class, and Stanford used AI to find a natural molecule that curbs appetite and promotes fat loss, so far in animals. I saw these as listings only, not the full write-ups.

items.headline: GTA 6 preload settled: 10 November, up to 212GB
items.summary: Rockstar has confirmed it, clearing up the dispute in the last two briefs. Xbox opens at midnight Irish time, PS5 at midnight local, and launch on 19 November is also midnight local; the 12 November date now applies to code-in-box copies at retail.

items.headline: Elder Scrolls VI 'Sentinel': still not nailed down
items.summary: A fresh look turned up only October reports of the name and a tipped November reveal, not the Bethesda confirmation KeenGamer described yesterday. Keep treating it as likely, not official.

items.headline: Watchlist quiet
items.summary: I found nothing new on Witcher 4, Cyberpunk 2, Witcher 3 or Borderlands today; VGTimes' newest Witcher 4 item is a 30 October piece on Doug Cockle. Several big gaming sites wouldn't load, so this is 'nothing found' rather than 'nothing happened'.

items.headline: Sunday's Crown: Mica's first appearance at the event
items.summary: Mica Galvão heads a middleweight field with Jackson Nagai, José Steve, Leonardo Souza, Rafael Gamba and Tarcisio Santos at the Pyramid in Long Beach. The line-up piece dates from September, and FloGrappling's schedule lists 18:00 Irish time, though another page shows a different time.

items.headline: Otherwise quiet before the weekend
items.summary: I found no fresh grappling news from the last 48 hours. FloGrappling's calendar has Fight to Win 329 and ADCC Brazilian Nationals on Saturday, with Polaris 40 pencilled in for 21 November.

items.headline: UFC Vegas 124: Walker's heavyweight step-up gets the main event
items.summary: Cortes-Acosta vs Johnny Walker was promoted after Sean Brady's injury scrapped Brady vs Bonfim. Walker comes up from light heavyweight after knocking out Mick Parkin at UFC 332, and Cortes-Acosta has never been finished as a pro.

items.headline: Strawweight contender fight on Saturday, with one Brit to watch
items.summary: Tatiana Suarez and Virna Jandiroba, both ranked top-five, meet in the co-main. England's Davey Grant faces Elijah Smith on the main card. I found no Irish fighters on the card, and most major MMA news sites wouldn't load today.

items.headline: Haas drops Ocon for the rest of 2026, Camara steps in
items.summary: Haas says Ocon won't return to a race seat this season after a reported row with Komatsu and his engineer in Mexico; he denies any physical violence. Rafael Camara, released early by Ferrari, makes his debut alongside Bearman in São Paulo, while Hirakawa is at Monza.

items.headline: Hamilton's 400th arrives with Ferrari's feud simmering
items.summary: He joins Alonso as the only drivers to reach 400 races, at a track where Ferrari will be managing the fallout from Leclerc's opening-lap move in Mexico, which cost them a likely one-two. Brundle's view is that Ferrari's promises it won't recur won't hold.

items.headline: Mercedes can seal the constructors' at Interlagos
items.summary: Covers has them 126 points clear of Ferrari, needing to outscore them by three on Sunday. The race is at 17:00 Irish time, with no sprint this weekend.

items.headline: WEC Monza: Hirakawa's car needs only fifth for the Hypercar title
items.summary: The #8 Toyota of Buemi, Hartley and Hirakawa leads the sister #7 114-97, and the #7 needs a win, pole and the #8 down in sixth or worse. TF Sport also take the LMGT3 teams' crown with fifth; there's no GT World Challenge Europe news today.
